newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-M inflation index up 0.34 pct Nov 21-30.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-M inflation index up 0.34 pct Nov 21-30.

text.p: Prices in Brazil rose 0.34 percent in the Novomber 21-30 period, according to the IGP-M index released by the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV).
The IGP-M index rose 0.11 percent in the October 21-31 period.

The IGP-M is composed by three other economic indicators: the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.52 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which was unchanged; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.48 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting in the IGP-M, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
